Title: A reading list for slower days
Date: 2026-11-01
Type: Note
Collection: Learning
Author: Alex Morgan

I want to read about attention, urban gardens, and walking journals this month. These are subjects to explore, rather than books I have already finished. One reading session each weekend should be enough.

The question I want to keep beside my notes is: what makes an idea easy to find again? Saving a useful passage without the question that led to it often loses the context.

For the Studio project, I might try a small reading space that keeps the original note visible. This is an idea to discuss with Sam Chen, not an agreed requirement yet.
